title: Choose the visual world
question: Three directions for Today, sketched on a phone. Keep the roll, take an alternate, or re-roll. The one you lock becomes the full clickable prototype.

options.label: Métro Line
options.lineage: Montréal métro line diagrams and station signage
options.thesis: The Program is a métro line to Race day: every Week a station, every Session a stop.
options.viewport: A navy sign band with the whole 27-week line in Phase colours and you-are-here; Next stop with the treadmill target; this Week's stops on a vertical line.
options.risk: Phase colours can read as a transit costume if the line stops doing real work on Plan and Progress.

raised.raise: Session status is drawn in line form as well as colour: solid done, dashed optional, struck skipped.
Stop markers scale with importance: the Key session's stop is drawn larger than the rest.
Plan packs all 27 Weeks into one grid of stops, each Session's state marked at a glance.
Live-session numerals are set monumental on a strict grid; nothing competes with the speed.
Every Suggestion is paired with the number that triggered it.

options.label: Lanes ’76
options.lineage: Montréal 1976 Olympic identity program: five-stripe lettering and lane lines
options.thesis: Training drawn in track lanes: the countdown, the Week and every Session run in parallel stripes.
options.viewport: A cobalt field holds a huge striped 168-day countdown over five lanes; below, Up next and the Week as colour-coded lanes by Session type.
options.risk: Retro-sport pastiche if the stripes decorate instead of carrying progress; the most familiar of the three for a Montréal sports subject.

options.label: Gate Board
options.lineage: airport departure boards and segmented boarding passes
options.thesis: The Week is a departures board that reranks itself; today's Session is your boarding pass.
options.viewport: A dark board lists the Week's Sessions by readiness with NOW lit; below, a white pass segments the next Session into speed, incline, reps and time.
options.case: Fuses cleanly: Up next is a live rerank and a changed Prescription holds its alert colour until seen; loses on identification, since travel is not the athlete's world.
options.risk: Becomes an airline costume if the pass grows barcodes and flight jargon.

options.label: Grid Specimen
options.thesis: Numbers built cell by cell on a visible grid.
options.viewport: A grid-built pace number fills the screen.
options.case: Fuses poorly: type-design culture is not the athlete's; clarity is fine but no better than the roll.
options.risk: Reads as a poster, not a working app.
options.kept: Monumental numerals on a strict grid for the Live session.

options.label: Star Atlas
options.thesis: Sessions as stars ranked by magnitude.
options.viewport: A night chart of the Week's Sessions.
options.case: Fuses poorly: no athlete identification, and a night sky obscures the next action.
options.risk: Mystical mood over a training task.
options.kept: Marker size on a fixed ramp to show importance.

options.label: Emission Rail
options.thesis: Everything hangs off one calibrated rail.
options.viewport: A single rail with the Week as hairline ticks.
options.case: Fuses poorly: abstract and dim for a phone on a treadmill.
options.kept: State carried by line form, not colour alone.

options.label: Event Catalog
options.thesis: Hundreds of stamp-size cells on one numbered grid.
options.viewport: A packed grid of every Session in the Program.
options.case: Fuses poorly: not the athlete's culture, and too dense for Today.
options.risk: Visual noise on the screen that must give one answer.
options.kept: One packed grid of the whole Program with marked state.

options.label: Monochrome Product
options.thesis: Near-black on near-white, every claim beside its proof.
options.case: Fuses poorly: a marketing grammar, and the user ruled out clinical.
options.kept: Every assertion paired with its evidence.

canonCard.label: The category standard
canonCard.thesis: A clean fitness app: rounded cards, one sporty accent, weekly ring and charts.
canonCard.viewport: Greeting, a workout card with Start, a weekly ring and a list of remaining workouts.
canonCard.risk: Indistinguishable from every training app by design.
